subject: Mythology
title: Manga and Anime as Mythology Carriers
description: A micro-lesson that makes Manga and Anime as Mythology Carriers usable.

hook.text: Anime and manga are the most powerful vehicles for spreading Japanese mythology to a global audience.

buildup.text: Naruto draws from yokai and ninja lore. Dragon Ball borrows from the Chinese Journey to the West epic.

discovery.text: Demon Slayer, Inuyasha, and Natsume feature yokai as central characters, teaching millions about Japanese folklore.

twist.text: Most global fans absorb Japanese mythology through anime without realizing they are learning Shinto concepts.

climax.text: Anime is now a $25 billion global industry. Japanese myths reach more people than ever in history.

punchline.text: Japan exported its mythology through cartoons better than through books.

quiz.question: Which anime series is heavily based on yokai mythology?
